parent_objective: run a bounded no-residual metadata smoke for the current public-gate base
blocked_by: adapter must be smoke-tested before any source-rich mining or proof conversion
invalidates: treating untested adapter output as source-rich evidence

public_gates: M1183 may run only a small metadata smoke
M1183 must not run full source-rich mining
M1183 must not run wrong-history replay or proof conversion
M1183 must not train actor weights
M1183 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim paper evidence from smoke metadata

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_infra: current-base no-residual source-rich adapter smoke
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: checks that the adapter can emit source-rich metadata artifacts for the current public-gate base
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure smoke only; no source-rich mining, proof, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if smoke requires residual-head input
stop if smoke changes actor inputs
stop if required metadata fields are missing
stop if smoke expands into mining or proof conversion
fallback_plan: if metadata is missing, route to adapter instrumentation repair
if no snapshots are generated, route to smoke parameter redesign
if adapter requires residual-head state, route to M1182 failure audit

training_stage.stage_objective: run a small adapter metadata smoke without training or proof conversion
admission_evidence: M1182 implements current-base no-residual adapter tooling
M1182 focused tests validate parser and metadata contract
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1183 is infrastructure smoke only and adds no self-ID behavior evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1183 only checks metadata plumbing for later evidence collection.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If smoke fails, classify as adapter instrumentation or smoke-parameter failure rather than self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The no-residual adapter can emit a small source-rich metadata smoke for the current public-gate base without residual-head dependency or actor-input changes.
success_criteria: no residual-head CLI or artifact is used
no mining, proof conversion, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: mining, proof conversion, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1183 passes only if the adapter smoke writes metadata artifacts without residual-head dependency and without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, proof conversion, or actor-input changes.
